objects.label: Tavern Door
objects.description: Heavy wooden door between tavern and dungeon room. Passable when open, connects rooms.

objects.label: Bar Counter A
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment (left section). Impassable fixture, cost_multiplier 999 effectively blocks pathfinding.

objects.label: Bar Counter B
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment (middle section). Impassable fixture, cost_multiplier 999 effectively blocks pathfinding.

objects.label: Bar Counter C
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment (right section). Impassable fixture, cost_multiplier 999 effectively blocks pathfinding.

objects.label: Round Table A
objects.description: Moveable round tavern table. Can be pushed by players (movable=true). Impassable but cost_multiplier 2 for potential movement.

objects.label: Long Table A
objects.description: Moveable long wooden table. Can be pushed by players (movable=true). Impassable but cost_multiplier 2 for potential movement.

objects.label: Stool Stack
objects.description: Stacked stools that can be moved. Passable (entities can share hex) and stackable. cost_multiplier 1.5 indicates slight movement impediment.

objects.label: Crate Stack
objects.description: Supply crates stacked near the wall. Moveable and stackable. Impassable but cost_multiplier 3 for potential movement.

objects.label: Stone Fireplace
objects.description: Large stone fireplace providing warmth and light. Fixed decor, completely impassable.

objects.label: Decorative Rug
objects.description: Woven tavern floor rug. Purely decorative, does not impede movement.
